caption: The drawing depicts two objects: a rectangular box with rounded corners and its matching lid, both shown separately. The exterior surfaces of both the box and the lid are predominantly painted in a light blue color. The lid, oriented with its top visible, has a floral motif in the upper right corner, featuring a pale flower with green leaves and a stem, as well as a vertical border of alternating green and beige flowers on the left. White decorative patterns are also present. The open box, shown in perspective with the interior visible, has inner walls painted in a muted grayish tone and outer surfaces matching the lid’s light blue color. The vertical sides of the box show green and white streaks and clouds, with a horizontal band near the base decorated with green leaves and beige flowers, matching the lid’s decoration. The upper rim of the box appears outlined in a thin yellow or gold line. The background is a plain, untextured beige.
title: Bandbox
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
